newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah fluctuates as investors cautious.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah fluctuates as investors cautious.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fluctuated against the dollar in thin trading on Friday as operators were cautious in the wake of the central bank's surprising recent moves, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,401.60/02.00 at 0335 GMT after weakening some three points in early trading. It opened at 2,399.50/400.50.
"Players preferred to stay sidelined as they needed more time to digest all the recent surprising moves by the central bank before making any new decisions," one foreign bank dealer said.
The dealer said the rupiah's relatively strong fluctuation was expected as there were only a few players in the market which made it easier to influence the rupiah's movement.
The recent moves included the central bank's decision to cut its key discount rates for short-term securities (SBPUs) by 50 basis points on Wednesday.
The central bank also increased its fixing rates by two points on Wednesday and lowered them by one point on Thursday.

Alex Erskine, a regional economist with Citibank in Singapore, told Reuters Financial Television on Friday the central bank recent's moves over the fixing rate and its lowering of a key discount rate suggested a policy of "constructive ambiguity."
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,388/2,580 and the conversion rate also by one point to 2,388/2,436 late on Friday.
Overnight swap was last quoted at 0.15/0.20 and tom/next at 0.10/0.15. One-month swap was last at 9.50/10.00, two at 21.00/21.50, three at 32.50/33.50 and six at 71.50/73.00.
